# Elixir

*A rare potion of legend. Restores half of your HP and MP.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Type | Consumable |
| Effect | Restores 50% HP and 50% MP |
| Sells for | 1,500 mesos |

## How to get

- Dropped by [Mano](../monsters/mano.md), [The Snail King](../bosses/snail_king.md) (Normal) (15%)
- Dropped by [The Snail King](../bosses/snail_king.md) (Hard) (40%)
- Sold at [Mirel's Potions](../shops/selsior_potions.md) for 3,000 mesos
- Reward from [Kaldemor Gauntlet](../runs/kaldemor_gauntlet.md)
- Given on becoming a [Grand Swordmaster](../jobs/grand_swordmaster.md)
- Given on becoming a [Sword Saint](../jobs/sword_saint.md)
